Statue of Liberty walking tour.description: Statue City Cruises general admission from Battery Park includes round-trip ferry, Liberty and Ellis islands, museums, and audio tours. Adults: $26.00 (fees included per statuecitycruises.com and NPS fee page). Allow airport-style screening at Castle Clinton and arrive early for timed ferry boarding.
